title: Bible Strand Question(s) Patriarchs Bible Abraham Patriarchs
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child recounts Genesis 12:1-5: God tells Abram to leave his country for a land God will show him and promises to make him a great nation; Abram obeys at 75 with Sarai and Lot; in Genesis 17:5 God changes his name to Abraham, father of many nations.
representations: a map from Haran to Canaan
a time line with the call (75) and the new name (99)
steps: God speaks: leave and go to the land I will show you.
God promises a great nation and a blessing.
Abram obeys and takes Sarai and Lot.
Later God changes his name to Abraham.
contexts: a family moving to a new town for work
a naming ceremony in the community

board.do: Draw a road from Haran to Canaan.
Point at the end of the road.
board.say: Did God tell Abram the name of the place before he left?

board.do: Wait for the child to say no, God would show him.
Write: Abram means exalted father; Abraham means father of many nations.

misconceptions.ask: What did God say about the land Abram would go to?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 12:1 and find the words "that I will show you".

misconceptions.ask: Who went with Abram to the new land?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 12:4-5 and list the people named.

misconceptions.ask: What did God change Abram's name to, and what does it mean?
misconceptions.repair: Read Genesis 17:5 aloud: "I have made you a father of many nations".

misconceptions.ask: How old was Abram when he left Haran (Genesis 12:4)?
misconceptions.repair: Put two cards on a time line: Genesis 12, age 75, the call; Genesis 17, age 99, the new name.

checks.question: What does the name Abraham mean?
Who went with Abram?
checks.answer: Sarai his wife and Lot his nephew
